attach-screenshot: Attach a screenshot of what you saw
no-screenshot: No screenshot, it could not be taken
include-details: Include game details and the log lines about these mods
summary: The report holds your text and rating, plus: {0}. Your name, home folder, server address and IPs are removed from logs.
summary-only-text: The report holds only your text and rating.
saved: Feedback saved in {0}. Type .uf folder to open it.
save-failed: Could not save the feedback, see client-main.log.
save-partly-failed: Feedback saved, but part of it could not be written, see client-main.log.
consent: This uploads your report (your text, rating and what the summary lists) to {0}, a site chosen by the mod's author. Neither UserFeedback nor Vintage Story runs it. Send it there? You'll only be asked once for this site.
sent-github: A new GitHub issue for {0} opened in your browser, check it and press Submit there. The report folder opened too, drag the screenshot and logs into the issue if you like.
sent-webpage: The report is copied, paste it into the page that opened on {0}.
http-sent-id: Report sent to {0}, thank you! Its reference is {1}.
http-rate-limited: {0} got too many reports, try again later.
http-not-accepted: {0} doesn't accept reports for this mod (error {1}).
http-too-large: The report is too large for {0}, try without the full logs.
http-unreachable: Couldn't reach {0}, check your internet connection.
send-failed: Couldn't send the report, it's kept in {0}. See client-main.log.
